description: Faculty proficiency must be greater than or equal to course min_proficiency on all required syllabus tags
Total assigned weekly contact hours must not exceed faculty max_weekly_load_hours
No overlapping time slots permitted for the same faculty member across assigned sections
No faculty assignment during approved leave terms or during designated unavailable time slots
Number of distinct course preparations assigned to faculty must not exceed max_preparations
Every active course section in the scenario must be assigned to exactly one faculty member
Required course resources must be available and assigned resource capacity must accommodate section expected size
Maximize faculty expertise fit score with assigned course content
Minimize teaching load imbalance and standard deviation across faculty of equal rank
Honor faculty explicit course preferences whenever feasible
Foster pedagogical continuity by re-assigning courses taught by the same instructor in previous terms
Respect faculty contractual minimum course assignment floor (min_courses)
